title: After the Facts #1 of 2 Randy Lander Farabee Turnage Indie Comic Gail Simone
conditionDescription: Cover clean with light handling wear, minor edge rubbing. Please review the photos.
descriptionText:
After the Facts #1 (of 2) -- small-press indie comic by Randy Lander, Farabee and Turnage. "Love on the rocks... with a splash of adventure!" 40 pages, with a cover blurb from Gail Simone (Deadpool, Killer Princesses). ISBN 0-9723086-0-1. Cover price $3.99 US.

Condition: Very Good. Cover clean with light handling wear and minor edge rubbing to the black cover. Please review the photos - they are of the actual copy you will receive.
